summary: iter68 — HOT SHOT TMS end-to-end regression PASSED. Backend 9/9 pytest (test_iter68_hotshot.py) — lead POST (public) validates email (400 on bad), rejects missing name (422), returns ok on valid; GET /api/hotshot/leads with admin bearer test_session_admin_1 returns 200 (NOTE: require_role('owner','dispatcher') implicitly allows admin — verified working, so the pre-flagged 403 concern does NOT reproduce); unauthenticated GET → 401; POST /leads/{id}/status with 'contacted' persists (re-GET confirms); 'bogus' status → 400; unknown lead_id → 404; /one-pager.pdf → 200 %PDF, application/pdf, >1KB. Frontend Playwright: (1) Unauth GET /hotshot correctly REDIRECTS to /login (ProtectedRoute active); (2) After localStorage.tms_session_token=test_session_admin_1, /hotshot renders data-testid=hotshot-landing with ALL required sections: hs-live-stats (animated counters 131/4+/32/3), hs-week-one (5 day cards DAY1-5 visible), hs-capability-map (5 category groups: AI Suite, Live Operations, Money & Back Office, Paperwork & Compliance, Intelligence & Reporting; 28 module cards counted from screenshot: 6+6+6+6+4), hs-sandbox-spotlight, hs-tier-starter (contains $390), hs-tier-growth (contains $975), hs-tier-donewithyou (contains $2,600), plus lead form (hs-lead-name-input, hs-lead-email-input, hs-lead-company-input, hs-lead-fleet_or_volume-input, hs-lead-tier-select, hs-lead-message-input, hs-lead-submit-btn). (3) Lead form submit → hs-lead-success appears; (4) Sidebar Zap regression FIXED: /dashboard renders with sidebar visible, nav-hotshot-sales+nav-dashboard present, no 'Zap is not defined' or ReferenceError on /dashboard or /brokerage; (5) Clicking nav-hotshot-sales navigates to /hotshot-sales, new lead visible in hs-leads-card by email; (6) Row status select (hs-lead-status-{lead_id}) changed 'new'→'contacted' persists after full page reload AND backend GET confirms status=contacted. Full round-trip lead capture → pipeline → status persistence VERIFIED.
critical_code_review_comments: routes/hotshot.py:168 — list_leads uses require_role('owner','dispatcher'); admin currently works (require_role must implicitly grant admin). If require_role behavior ever changes, add 'admin' explicitly to be safe: require_role('admin','owner','dispatcher').
routes/hotshot.py:159 — count_documents by email pre-insert is fine at low volume but O(N) on unindexed field; consider a MongoDB index on hotshot_leads.email if list grows.
routes/hotshot.py:52 _one_pager_pdf() rebuilds the entire PDF on every request (no cache). Static content — cache the bytes at module load or use lru_cache; save ~20-50ms per request.

HotShotLanding.jsx — day cards inside hs-week-one and module cards inside hs-capability-map do NOT have individual data-testid attributes (only the section-level ones). This is fine for the current test spec, but adding hs-week-one-day-{n} and hs-cap-module-{slug} would let future regressions target cards individually.
App.js:157 — /hotshot is now inside ProtectedRoute (correct per spec). If a future requirement wants a public marketing variant, keep this route auth-gated and add a separate /hotshot-public route.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all sections render, auth-gating works, lead round-trip works, status persistence works, no Zap regression)
